safety.text: Version 0.17.0-alpha.17: new battery and heating-buffer outputs are disabled and unmapped by default. Heat-pump modes are advice only, without an external mode write. Before enabling any real output, stop competing output scripts and commission it under supervision. Before returning to scripts, disable the master release and wait until all OutputOwned states are false. Host or driver failure requires independent device-side protection; an EMS process cannot guarantee a final stop after a host crash.

houseConnectionHelp.text: The adapter derives one common working limit (fuse minus reserve) for wallboxes and DHW. Legacy separate limits remain readable only for migration.

par14aActiveHigh.label: Binary contact: true/1 means limitation active

measurementHelp.text: Required for normal operation: PV power and either grid import/export or an equivalent mapped source. Values are expected in watts. Explicit fields override legacy JSON entries.

text.en: Prices and tariffs
text.de: Preise und Tarife

text.en: Forecast prices and tariff windows use 15-minute intervals. Real-time power control continues at its configured seconds interval. All resulting prices are gross ct/kWh.
text.de: Prognosepreise und Tarifzeiten werden in 15-Minuten-Intervallen verarbeitet. Die Leistungsregelung arbeitet weiter im eingestellten Sekundentakt. Alle berechneten Preise sind brutto in ct/kWh.

text.en: Existing amounts are preserved without automatic reinterpretation. Review whether the fixed energy component, fixed grid fee, energy adders and external grid-fee series are net or gross. This selector applies to these four inputs; exchange prices and the annual tariff have their own basis.
text.de: Bisherige Beträge bleiben ohne automatische Umdeutung erhalten. Bitte prüfen, ob fester Energieanteil, festes Netzentgelt, Energieaufschläge und externe Netzentgeltreihe netto oder brutto sind. Diese Auswahl gilt für diese vier Eingaben; Börsenpreise und Jahrestarif haben eine eigene Preisart.

text.en: Price-based charging
text.de: Preisabhängiges Laden

text.en: Enable price-based grid charging separately on the Battery tab or each Wallbox tab. The comparison uses the full gross price including energy, adders and grid fees. A fixed energy tariff with time-dependent grid fees also works. Expected usable PV reduces the required grid energy. A departure time takes precedence; otherwise the horizon above applies (default 24 h). Blocks avoid chasing each quarter-hour. Existing master, device and production releases still apply.
text.de: Preisabhängiges Netzladen im Reiter Speicher oder je Wallbox separat aktivieren. Verglichen wird der gesamte Bruttopreis aus Energie, Aufschlägen und Netzentgelten. Das funktioniert auch mit festem Energiepreis und zeitabhängigen Netzentgelten. Erwartete nutzbare PV verringert die benötigte Netzenergie. Eine Abfahrtszeit hat Vorrang; sonst gilt der obige Horizont (Standard 24 h). Ladeblöcke vermeiden Wechsel in jeder Viertelstunde. Master-, Geräte- und Produktivfreigaben gelten weiterhin.

text.en: Fixed electricity tariff
text.de: Fester Stromtarif

label.en: Contract total price with reference grid fee
Grid fee included in contract price (gross)

text.en: Enter your actual contract price. The energy component is total price minus the included reference grid fee; the applicable grid fee is then added per interval. Both inputs in this mode are always gross. A total price of 0 is not configured.
text.de: Den tatsächlichen Vertragspreis eintragen. Energieanteil = Gesamtpreis minus enthaltenes Referenz-Netzentgelt; anschließend wird je Intervall das gültige Netzentgelt ergänzt. Beide Eingaben in diesem Modus sind immer brutto. Ein Gesamtpreis von 0 ist nicht eingerichtet.

label.en: Fixed grid fee (dynamic grid fee disabled)

text.en: Dynamic energy prices
text.de: Dynamische Energiepreise

text.en: Energy-Charts supplies actual published DE-LU quarter-hour prices in EUR/MWh, always net. The adapter converts the unit and adds VAT once. Unpublished intervals remain missing and cannot authorize price-dependent operation.
text.de: Energy-Charts liefert die veröffentlichten DE-LU-Viertelstundenpreise in EUR/MWh, immer netto. Der Adapter rechnet die Einheit um und ergänzt die MwSt. einmalig. Noch unveröffentlichte Intervalle bleiben fehlend und geben keinen preisabhängigen Betrieb frei.

text.en: Grid fees
text.de: Netzentgelte

text.en: An external enable data point overrides its internal switch. Missing or invalid external switch values disable that dynamic source and are reported in diagnostics. Selecting a source alone does not enable it.
text.de: Ein externer Freigabedatenpunkt ersetzt den zugehörigen internen Schalter. Fehlende oder ungültige Schalterwerte deaktivieren die dynamische Quelle und werden in der Diagnose gemeldet. Die Quellenauswahl allein aktiviert sie nicht.

text.en: Annual grid tariff
text.de: Jahrestarif Netzentgelte

text.en: Editable example: Avacon 2026, module 3. Confirm prices, eligibility and tariff year against your own agreement. Time windows apply daily in Europe/Berlin, including daylight-saving changes. Each quarter must cover 00:00–24:00 without gaps or overlaps. Use quarter-hour boundaries; split a window at midnight. An expired or incomplete tariff is reported as invalid and cannot authorize price-dependent operation.
text.de: Bearbeitbares Beispiel: Avacon 2026, Modul 3. Preise, Anwendbarkeit und Tarifjahr mit dem eigenen Vertrag abgleichen. Zeitfenster gelten täglich in Europe/Berlin, auch bei Zeitumstellung. Jedes Quartal muss 00:00–24:00 lückenlos und ohne Überschneidung abdecken. Viertelstundengrenzen verwenden; Zeitfenster an Mitternacht aufteilen. Ein abgelaufener oder unvollständiger Tarif wird als ungültig gemeldet und gibt keinen preisabhängigen Betrieb frei.

label.de: AC-Ladeenergie je Anstecken bei fehlendem SoC

text.en: With valid vehicle SoC, the existing target determines the energy needed. Without SoC, enter the AC energy to add per plug-in session (0 = no price-based grid charging without SoC). Measured charging reduces the remaining session energy; a restart does not reset it. Usable PV is planned first. An enabled departure time takes precedence; otherwise the configured horizon applies (default 24 h). The price cap is the full gross price including time-dependent grid fees; 0 means no additional cap. User permission, master, device and production releases remain required.
text.de: Bei gültigem Fahrzeug-SoC bestimmt das bestehende Ladeziel die benötigte Energie. Ohne SoC die AC-Ladeenergie je Anstecken vorgeben (0 = kein preisabhängiges Netzladen ohne SoC). Gemessene Ladung reduziert den Restbedarf der Sitzung; ein Neustart setzt ihn nicht zurück. Nutzbare PV wird zuerst eingeplant. Eine aktivierte Abfahrtszeit hat Vorrang; sonst gilt der eingestellte Horizont (Standard 24 h). Die Preisgrenze ist der volle Bruttopreis inklusive zeitabhängiger Netzentgelte; 0 bedeutet keine zusätzliche Grenze. Benutzer-, Master-, Geräte- und Produktivfreigaben bleiben erforderlich.

_heatingOutputHelp.text: Independent my-PV controller for the heating buffer; never reuse the DHW actuator. Requires its own setpoint, three measured output powers, connection and buffer temperature. Cooling active, unknown cooling status or manual inhibit blocks heating. Temperature limits do not replace the heater's physical thermostat and safety cut-out.

heatingProductionArmed.label: Arm heating-buffer output: separate actuator verified and competing writer stopped

heatingOutletTempId.label: Optional heating-buffer controller outlet temperature (°C; configured source must be valid)

heatingTempC.label: Manual fallback temperature for planning only; not a productive sensor

_batteryOutputHelp.text: Supervised SunEnergy battery output: choose the exact sunenergyxt500.N.heads.H.control.GS endpoint and its mandatory AC power feedback heads.H.grid.GP (or total.gridPower only with exactly one configured head). Both GS and GP are positive for discharge/export; the EMS inverts GP to internal positive=charge. BP / total.batteryPower is DC telemetry for history/planning and must not replace AC command feedback. The SunEnergy adapter must use controlMode=off, a fresh info.lastUpdate heartbeat and the selected head must confirm online=true, MM=false and LM=true. A direct GS command has no EMS-side protection against a host crash: a device-side watchdog remains necessary for unattended operation.

text.de: Preisabhängiges Speicherladen

label.en: Allow battery grid charging in selected low-price periods
label.de: Speicher-Netzladen in ausgewählten günstigen Zeiten erlauben

label.en: Maximum total gross price (0 = no cap)

text.en: Opt-in grid charging is scheduled against expected demand, PV, storage losses and later total electricity prices. The extra reserve is in percentage points above the configured minimum SoC, capped by the maximum SoC. The price cap uses the full gross price, including time-dependent grid fees; negative caps are allowed. 0 means no additional price cap, not free electricity. Missing prices do not authorize grid charging. Existing master, device and battery production releases remain required.
text.de: Optionales Netzladen wird anhand von erwartetem Bedarf, PV, Speicherverlusten und späteren Strom-Gesamtpreisen geplant. Die zusätzliche Reserve zählt in Prozentpunkten über dem eingestellten Mindest-SoC, begrenzt durch den Maximal-SoC. Die Preisgrenze gilt für den vollen Bruttopreis einschließlich zeitabhängiger Netzentgelte; negative Grenzen sind erlaubt. 0 bedeutet keine zusätzliche Preisgrenze, nicht kostenlosen Strom. Fehlende Preise geben kein Netzladen frei. Master-, Geräte- und Speicher-Produktivfreigabe bleiben erforderlich.

_batteryFineControlHeader.text: Battery fine control and input checks

batteryFineReserveW.label: PV reserve for battery fine control before heater allocation

_batteryFineReserveHelp.text: Reserves up to this share of actual PV surplus for battery fine control. The effective reserve is capped by available PV, battery charge power and the shared grid-operator budget; without available PV there is no reserve. Existing planned battery charging can require a larger share. This is a power reserve in watts, not an additional SoC reserve or permission to charge from the grid.

_batteryMinimumHelp.text: The 15% minimum applies to new installations only. Existing explicit settings are retained. A minimum of 0% blocks productive discharge; configure an appropriate positive reserve before a supervised test.

heatPumpHeader.text: Heat pump: slow mode advice only

heatPumpControlEnabled.label: Heat pump strategy release (no external actuator write)

heatPumpPowerId.label: Current electrical heat-pump power for §14a budget

_heatPumpAdviceHelp.text: NORMAL / BOOST / REDUCED are EMS-owned recommendations, not commands to the heat pump. No ISG mode endpoint is written. Advice uses measured buffer/DHW temperatures, PV surplus, the optional shared cheap-price policy and the cooling status configured in Thermal strategy. Independent heat-pump safety and its own temperature control remain authoritative.

heatPumpBufferTemperatureId.label: Heat-pump buffer temperature (empty = configured heating-buffer temperature source)

heatPumpDhwTemperatureId.label: Heat-pump DHW temperature (explicit source; no automatic sensor selection)

heatPumpHeatingTargetC.label: Heating buffer target for heat-pump advice

heatPumpPvBoostOnW.label: PV surplus to enter BOOST advice

heatPumpPvBoostOffW.label: PV surplus to leave BOOST advice

_heatPumpHysteresisHelp.text: The BOOST entry threshold must be positive and greater than the exit threshold. Safety blocks and loss of price permission can end advice before the normal holding time expires.

_thermalSharedHelp.text: Shared cooling information protects the heating-buffer heater and informs heat-pump advice. DHW is a separate thermal circuit. Optional cheap-price heating remains disabled unless explicitly released with a positive combined heater grid-power budget; missing prices are never treated as free energy.

heatingCoolingActiveId.label: Shared cooling active (confirmed true/1 = cooling; false/0 = no cooling)

heatingCoolingHeartbeatId.label: Optional cooling-source heartbeat (fresh epoch-ms timestamp; allows unchanged cooling boolean)

thermalCheapPriceEnabled.label: Allow explicitly budgeted heating at cheap total electricity prices

thermalCheapPriceMaxCt.label: Maximum total electricity price for cheap heating

thermalCheapGridMaxW.label: Maximum shared grid-power budget for cheap heater operation (0 = no grid heating)

thermalCheapFixedTariffAllowed.label: Also allow cheap-price heating with an explicitly configured fixed tariff

advancedHelp.text: Migration only: explicit fields on the normal tabs override matching legacy JSON entries. Unchanged JSON entries remain active so updates do not lose existing mappings.

legacyCurrentHelp.text: The legacy free-current values below are used only when direct phase-current or phase-power measurements are unavailable.
